caption: Supplementary Fig. 5 | Recurrence retention and held-out environmental information. a, A 2×2 design separates D/E subdivision from recurrence retention using identical cyclone identities, wind thresholds and legal intervals. F retains later near-peak episodes and bridges, whereas R is the continuous episode containing the first LMI; the late stage is Dec under F and a post-R tail under R. Of 2,340 cyclones, 2,217 have identical F and R durations and 123 gain duration under F. b,c, Empirical distributions of cyclone-level out-of-fold mean squared errors for shear and RH, with a symmetric-log horizontal scale. Every method retains the same 2,290 valid SIDs from the main sample. d,e, Actual-D/E-minus-reference differences in held-out native RMSE; negative values favour actual D/E. References pool D/E or use equal-time midpoint, quadratic normalized progress or quadratic age, with identical geographic and seasonal covariates. Models use 26,015 intervals, five SID-held-out folds and equal total weight per SID. Columns show paired RMSE differences; whiskers retain 95% percentiles from 2,000 paired-SID resamples of fixed predictions. These intervals condition on fitted predictions and exclude model-refitting uncertainty.
